component.id: case when agrmntmouNo is null then '-' else stuff((select ',' + mouNo from dboagrmntAssetMappingAms tempaam with(nolock) where tempaamassetNo = agrmntassetNo for xml path('')), 1, 1, '') endSearchId
component.label: Mou No
component.name: CASE WHEN agrmnt.MOU_NO IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE STUFF((SELECT ',' + MOU_NO FROM dbo.AGRMNT_ASSET_MAPPING_AMS TEMPAAM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE TEMPAAM.ASSET_NO = agrmnt.ASSET_NO FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') END

component.id: case when agrmntagrmntNo is null then '-' else stuff((select ',' + agrmntNo from dboagrmntAssetMappingAms tempaam with(nolock) where tempaamassetNo = agrmntassetNo for xml path('')), 1, 1, '') endSearchId
component.label: Agreement No
component.name: CASE WHEN agrmnt.AGRMNT_NO IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE STUFF((SELECT ',' + AGRMNT_NO FROM dbo.AGRMNT_ASSET_MAPPING_AMS TEMPAAM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE TEMPAAM.ASSET_NO = agrmnt.ASSET_NO FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') END

component.id: case when cacustName is null then '-' else case when xcountCust = 1 then cacustName else stuff((select ',' + catempcustName from dboagrmntAssetMappingAms tempaam with(nolock) left join dbocustAms catemp with(nolock) on catempcustNo = tempaamcustNo  where tempaamassetNo = agrmntassetNo for xml path('')), 1, 1, '') end endSearchId
component.label: Customer Name
component.name: CASE WHEN CA.CUST_NAME IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE CASE WHEN X.COUNT_CUST = 1 THEN CA.CUST_NAME ELSE STUFF((SELECT ',' + CATEMP.CUST_NAME FROM dbo.AGRMNT_ASSET_MAPPING_AMS TEMPAAM WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.CUST_AMS CATEMP WITH(NOLOCK) ON CATEMP.CUST_NO = TEMPAAM.CUST_NO  WHERE TEMPAAM.ASSET_NO = agrmnt.ASSET_NO FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') END END

component.id: case when assetdocdocStatCode = 'prp' or assetdocdocStatCode = 'wtg' then assetdocexpectedRcvDt else borrowexpectedReturnDt endSearchId
component.label: Expected Received Date
component.name: CASE WHEN assetDoc.DOC_STAT_CODE = 'PRP' OR assetDoc.DOC_STAT_CODE = 'WTG' THEN assetDoc.EXPECTED_RCV_DT ELSE borrow.EXPECTED_RETURN_DT END

headerList.label: Mou No
headerList.name: CASE WHEN X.COUNT_MOU > 1 THEN 'Multi Mou' WHEN agrmnt.MOU_NO IS NULL OR agrmnt.MOU_NO = '' THEN '-' ELSE agrmnt.MOU_NO END

headerList.label: Agreement No
headerList.name: CASE WHEN X.COUNT_AGRMNT > 1 THEN 'Multi Agreement' WHEN agrmnt.AGRMNT_NO IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE agrmnt.AGRMNT_NO END

headerList.label: Customer Name
headerList.name: CASE WHEN X.COUNT_CUST > 1 THEN 'Multi Customer' WHEN CA.CUST_NAME IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE CA.CUST_NAME END

headerList.label: Expected Received Date
headerList.name: CASE WHEN assetDoc.DOC_STAT_CODE = 'PRP' OR assetDoc.DOC_STAT_CODE = 'WTG' THEN ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar,assetDoc.EXPECTED_RCV_DT,106), '-')ELSE ISNULL(CONVERT (varchar,borrow.EXPECTED_RETURN_DT,106),'-')END
